changes_from_v2: lines: dspark_k7 added for M3; model_k3 dropped, its v2 numbers stand
gpu.node: the instance that replaced the v2 one on 2026-10-24, same GPU model; the new k0 runs are checked against v2's before any cross-instance comparison
panels: K128b added as the confirmation panel, with a new salt, D48 and K128 excluded, and the categories interleaved in proportion to their quotas (decision D7); K128 stays as v2 built it
confirm: K128b with k0, dflash_k7 and dspark_k7

gpu.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

order: all lines of one (C, seed) run back to back in one job; the i-th dev seed (0-based) starts with lines[i mod 3] and continues in listed order
kv_budget: C * ceil((max_prompt_len + max_tokens + 7) / 256) target blocks for every line; a block draft's cache mirrors the target's blocks

warmup.requests: first C of the panel, cycled

decision.a_beats_b: all paired gains same sign and abs(median) > 2*N_t
decision.report: median (min-max), two decimals; range only if max-min > 0.05

invalid_if: decode step or round > 3 x median
lines of one (C, seed) split across jobs

G2_real.revised: 2026-10-23 after the first run: both lines picked the same position, where the target split 0.5/0.5 over two tokens and the draft put all its mass on one; a one-hot q tests only the trivial residual, so q must now be positive on at least min_draft_support tokens
G2_real.revised_again: 2026-10-23 after the second run: both picked positions had a one-hot target p, so every rejection emits the one target token and the output-distribution check passes trivially (gap 0); p must now be positive on at least min_target_support tokens (decision D3)

G1_wide.revised: 2026-10-23 after the first run: decode alone moves logits by up to 1.5 between B=1 and B=16 on these prompts, so the fixed bound 0.5 was below the reference path's own batch-size noise; the bound is now floor_multiple x the decode-only noise floor measured on the same prompts in the same job (the rule G1-aux had)

dflash_alignment.rule: per temperature, |mean of nano's runs - mean of DeepSpec's| <= 2 x the standard error of that difference from the per-run means
dflash_alignment.revised: 2026-10-22 after the first runs: the per-round standard error treated the rounds of one prompt as independent; run-to-run spread (0.2-0.4) is far larger

upstream.metric: decode step p50 at full batch

vllm.runner_rule: draft_model runs only on the v1 model runner and dspark only on v2; every R divides by the k0 line of the same runner
vllm.dflash_rule: DeepSpec's DFlash checkpoint is a Qwen3DSparkModel without the Markov head, so dflash_k7 runs through vLLM's dspark method
vllm.adaptive_rule: adaptive verification needs TRITON_ATTN on sm_120; its gain is dspark_k7_adaptive over dspark_k7_triton, both on TRITON_ATTN
vllm.seed_rule: seeds.external[0] seeds the engine; requests carry no seed, so each repeat draws new random numbers

supplement.rule: the rec temperature without top-k/top-p: vLLM samples drafts with temperature only, so this shows what that costs it under rec
